subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Carcass
solution:
The correct answer is: **Corpse**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Carcass"** means the dead body of an animal. (मृत जानवर का शरीर)
 
 
• **Example: **The carcass of the deer was found in the forest.
 
 
 
• **"Corpse" **refers to the dead body of a human being. (लाश)
 
 
• **Example: **The corpse was discovered by hikers in the mountains.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Carcass' **is **'Corpse'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Corpse**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Gale **(आंधी): A very strong wind.
 
 
• **Example:** The gale blew down several trees last night.
 
 
 
• **Scrap **(रद्दी): A small piece or amount of something, especially one that is leftover after the greater part has been used.
 
 
• **Example:** She wrote her notes on scraps of paper.
 
 
 
• **Prison** (जेल): A building where people are legally held as a punishment for crimes they have committed.
 
 
• **Example:** The criminal was sent to prison for his crimes.
 
 

11e:T94e,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
